description: This file is a Jupyter Notebook that orchestrates the use of the GEMINI language model for generating SQL queries based on user questions related to a school database, executing those queries, and generating comprehensive natural language responses.

classes.name: GenerativeModel
classes.description: A class from the Google Generative AI SDK used to generate content based on prompts, specifically used here to produce SQL queries and answers.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts the SQL query enclosed between ```sql and ``` from the model's output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes the provided SQL query against the database and fetches all resulting rows.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Constructs a detailed prompt for translating user questions into SQL queries using database schema info.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt to generate a natural language answer from data, the query, and schema info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from the response object returned by the GEMINI model.
